import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT=Path('/Users/zel/projects/mana')
REVIEW=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CLI=ROOT/'scripts/mana-skill-factory.py'

def load(name,path):
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def state(project):
    entries={}
    for directory,dirs,names in os.walk(project,followlinks=False):
        dirs[:]=sorted(d for d in dirs if d!='.git')
        for name in sorted(names):
            p=Path(directory)/name
            entries[p.relative_to(project).as_posix()]=('symlink:'+os.readlink(p)) if p.is_symlink() else hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return {'files':len(entries),'digest':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(entries,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}

def invoke(project,candidate,command='generate'):
    argv=[sys.executable,str(CLI),command,'--project-root',str(project),'--candidate-dir',str(candidate)]
    if command=='generate': argv+=['--request','transaction-analysis']
    r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True)
    return {'exitCode':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}

results={}
project=Path('/private/tmp/mom-qual004-x92n0bvj/spring-petclinic')
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(project),*args],env={**os.environ,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0'},text=True).strip()
before=state(project)
git_before={'head':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),'status':git('status','--porcelain=v1')}
generated=REVIEW/'petclinic-candidate'
r=invoke(project,generated)
assert r['exitCode']==0,r
validation=invoke(project,ROOT/'docs/examples/mana-meta-skill-00/java-spring-transaction-analysis','validate')
assert validation['exitCode']==0,validation
same={name:(generated/name).read_bytes()==(ROOT/'docs/examples/mana-meta-skill-00/java-spring-transaction-analysis'/name).read_bytes() for name in ['SKILL.md','candidate.json']}
assert all(same.values())
after=state(project)
git_after={'head':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),'status':git('status','--porcelain=v1')}
assert before==after and git_before==git_after
results['petclinic']={'generation':r,'validation':validation,'before':before,'after':after,'gitBefore':git_before,'gitAfter':git_after,'identicalToDelivered':same}

fixture=load('factory_fixture',ROOT/'tests/mana-skill-factory.py')
test=fixture.FactoryTests()
test.setUp()
try:
    baseline=state(test.project)
    r=invoke(test.project,test.candidate)
    assert r['exitCode']==0,r
    candidate=json.loads((test.candidate/'candidate.json').read_text())
    assert candidate['evidence'][0]['declarations']==['org.springframework:spring-context']
    assert baseline==state(test.project)
    results['alternateJavaSpring']={'fixture':'FactoryTests.setUp/POM: example Service + direct spring-context','generation':r,'before':baseline,'after':state(test.project),'templateEqualsPetclinic':(test.candidate/'SKILL.md').read_bytes()==(generated/'SKILL.md').read_bytes(),'technologyClaims':candidate['technologyClaim']}
    (test.project/'pom.xml').write_text(fixture.POM.replace('org.springframework','com.example'))
    negative_baseline=state(test.project)
    negative=invoke(test.project,test.base/'negative-candidate')
    assert negative['exitCode']==2 and not (test.base/'negative-candidate').exists()
    assert negative_baseline==state(test.project)
    results['negativeTechnology']={'generation':negative,'projectUnchanged':True,'outputAbsent':True}
    (test.project/'pom.xml').write_text(fixture.POM)
    # Start a fresh interpreter so tempfile honors the same environment as the CLI.
    probe=r'''
import importlib.util,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('factory',sys.argv[1])
f=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(f)
project=Path(sys.argv[2]); candidate=Path(sys.argv[3])
actual=f.subprocess.run; staging=[]
def observed(argv,*args,**kwargs):
    stage=Path(argv[-1])
    staging.append({'path':str(stage),'insideTarget':project in stage.parents,'filesPresent':[str(p.relative_to(project)) for p in stage.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]})
    return actual(argv,*args,**kwargs)
f.subprocess.run=observed
result=f.generate(project,candidate)
print(json.dumps({'result':result,'staging':staging}))
'''
    before=state(test.project)
    observed=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',probe,str(CLI),str(test.project),str(test.base/'tmpdir-candidate')],env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(test.project),'TEMP':str(test.project),'TMP':str(test.project)},capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert observed.returncode==0,(observed.stdout,observed.stderr)
    observation=json.loads(observed.stdout)
    assert observation['staging'] and all(s['insideTarget'] for s in observation['staging'])
    assert state(test.project)==before
    results['temporaryIsolationFailure']={'environment':'TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP point to analyzed disposable project; fresh interpreter','observed':observation,'exitCode':observed.returncode,'finalSnapshotUnchanged':True,'actualTransientTargetWrites':True}
    nested='{"extra":'+ '['*2000+'0'+']'*2000+'}'
    (test.candidate/'candidate.json').write_text(nested)
    bad=invoke(test.project,test.candidate,'validate')
    assert bad['exitCode']==1 and 'RecursionError' in bad['stderr'],bad
    results['nestedUntrustedJson']={'bytes':len(nested),'exitCode':bad['exitCode'],'exception':'RecursionError','structuredBlockedResponse':False,'stderrTail':bad['stderr'].splitlines()[-1]}
finally:
    test.doCleanups()
index=subprocess.run(['bash',str(ROOT/'scripts/build-skill-index.sh')],capture_output=True)
assert index.returncode==0
assert index.stdout==(ROOT/'skills/index.yaml').read_bytes()
assert b'id: java-spring-transaction-analysis\n' not in index.stdout
results['index']={'matchesGenerated':True,'candidateDiscovered':False}
(REVIEW/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
